balls.text: seals the innings in a flourish! He stays at the crease and chips a fuller delivery high over mid-on who's up
Sensational running from Sachin! He pushes it to deep cover and there should never have been a second run, but Tendulkar blazes through for the second
well well he turns down the single! He makes room and scoops it towards Yusuf at deep cover, Sathish is sent back
full outside off and he makes room and drills it to deep cover, the throw is wide and he takes the second run
Orange Cap for Sachin! Trivedi drops the ball shorter and Tendulkar backs away and smacks it over deep midwicket, goes a few more rows back
the slower ball but Tendulkar gets enough power on the shot to clear wide long-on, he backs away and picks a pitched up delivery
short and drifting down the leg side and Sathish moves across his stumps to shovel it over fine leg but misses

oh Watson! Sathish mistimes the pull to Yusuf at short midwicket and goes for the run, he was miles out of his crease when Yusuf collected it and lobbed it to watson, the bowler made a mess of it and Sathish survives
comes down the wicket and chops it behind point this time
almost an action replay, Watson doesn't learn from his mistake and drops it short again, this time Tendulkar whams it even higher, over midwicket this time
he saw the field and picked his area, Watson drops it short and Tendulkar clears the back leg and clears wide mid-on
inside edge! Dole fires a yorker length on the off stump at raw pace, Pollard tries to drive from the crease but chops it to the leg stump
he bang it in short and he's penalised
slower ball and he tamely nudges it to the on side
into the crowd! Can we have the ball back please? Dole bowls length and Pollard punishes him by bending and muscling it high over wide long-on
Dole errs by bowling a low full toss which Pollard clubs down to long-off with the mid-off in the circle
well bowled , fires a yorker outside off and Pollard doesnt play a shot
comes down the pitch and goes for the inside out shot but gets a thick top edge which drops in the middle of nowhere at sweeper cover
he comes down the pitch to smack it out of the ground but ends up swishing at thin air
authoritative shot! Tendulkar uses the crease well to a pitched up delivery, moves his back leg across the stumps and golf swings it over mid-off
tucked to deep square leg and they think of taking a second run but settle for a single
stayed low and drifted towards the pads, gently nudged to fine leg with the fielder up, Watson won't be happy with that ball
full and crisply driven down to deep cover
another bouncer but he doesn't offer a shot this time
he advances down the pitch and Watson drops it short, he tries to carve it over point but ends up upper cutting over the keeper, seemed intentional
take that! Dole drops it a fraction short outside off and Pollard plays a powerful forehand to biff it past mid-off, top shot
stylishly flicks a full ball to deep midwicket and that's his fifty!
tucks it down to midwicket and gets Sachin on strike
full on  the off stump and pushes down to long-off
full on the pads and he flicks it forcefully down to deep midwicket, Raut does really well at deep midwicket to cut it off
comes round the wicket and he knocks it back to the bowler
Dropped! Tendulkar tries to hook a bouncer but gets a thick top edge, Dole had to run around at fine leg but he had it covered, lost it in the haze perhaps? Whatever, it could be a costly drop
well bowled! The slower ball and Tendulkar at first wanted to bend down and leave it and then tried to cheekily upper cut it, didn't make up his mind on time
bowls the short delivery but much quicker this time, Pollard pulls but keeps it down
gently tucked away towards square leg for a single
fetches it from outside off and checks the pull because of the lack of pace, two fielders patrol the deep to cut it off
slower ball on the pads and nudged to square leg
full on the off stump and driven down to deep mid-off
nudged behind square and short fine leg is fielding straight
forced towards deep midwicket and Raut does well to slide and cut it of
squeezes it down to deep midwicket and Sachin puts pressure on Lumb and pushes for the second run
tucks it down to the on side to retain the strike
slower ball but too wide down the leg side
drops it short, he ducks under the slower bouncer

close call! There was an appeal was a leg before but there was an inside edge, the ball rolls to the off side and Pollard ambles out of his crease before being sent back, Voges dives and has a shy at the stumps but misses with Pollard miles out of his crease, Voges could have done a Jonty and run the stumps down
mistimed! Trivedi drops it back of a length and there isn't much pace on the pitch for Duminy to go through with the pull, mistimes it straight to Lumb at short square leg who cups it above his head
stabbed to the off side
whipped away to the on side and Raut mops up at deep square leg just before the rope
make that three for the over! Warne bowls it flatter and drops it shorter, rocks back and cuts wide of backward point
worked to the on side
stylishly whipped away wide of midwicket
Tendulkar's acing this mini battle here, he comes down the pitch again to a flighted delivery and lofts even higher over extra cover
brings up the fifty partnership in style, chips down the track and lofts inside out over extra cover, effortless
full and driven down to mid-off
solid defense off the front foot, end of a good spell by Yusuf
driven to the off side for an easy single
down the leg side and another leg bye taken, clips his pads and rolls away
comes down the pitch and checks his sho, clips his pads and drops to the on side
clipped towards short fine leg for a quick single
clipped to midwicket
drops the ball shorter on seeing the batsman come forward, Duminy checks his shot and drops it to the off side
worked to Voges who fumbles at midwicket
driven down the pitch and warne gets a hand to it, deflects towards mid-on
hit on the pads but a long stride forward, stifled appeal
tossed up on the pads and swept down to long leg
floated on the pads and worked down to mid-off
Tendulkar wafts at it outside off, the ball was a touch wide outside off
stays beside the line and softly taps it to the off side
another crispy straight drive beats the bowler again and the fielders in the deep stop it
full on the stumps and driven firmly just wide of the bowler, long-off runs across to cut it off
stays beside the line, opens the face and angles it down to third man
comes over the wicket, he drifts on the pads and Duminy quietly tucks it to fine leg
gives it more air and Tendulkar leans forward and forces it wide of extra cover, long-off runs across and mops up
flatter delivery and worked down to long-on
on the leg stump and clipped to the on side
tossed up down the leg side and Tendulkar tries to paddle it away forcefully, misses it
tossed up on middle and clipped down to midwicket
no turn, tapped to the off side
tossed up on middle and off and he gets on his knee and sweeps firmly and picks the gap at square leg
full on the pads and clipped down to midwicket, Yusuf's keeping it to singles
angles it on the pads and he works it down to long leg
clipped behind square for a single
tossed up on the pads and tucked to square leg
down the leg side and clips his pads before reaching the keeper
gets forward and drives to mid-off
big appeal for a lbw! Pitches outside leg, clips the pads and beats the keeper, may have been an inside edge
flicked to square leg
he bowls it flat and short of a length, picks the length early, rocks back and slaps it past backward point
clipped straight to Voges at square leg
comes down the track but checks his stroke, the ball drops on the pitch
tossed up on the pads and clipped to square leg
full and driven down to Lumb at extra cover
full outside off and driven to the off side
misfield! Duminy drives straight to mid-off and Jhunjhunwala does a London bridge and lets it slip right through
nudged off his pads to the on side
comes on straight and he clips it down to square leg
streaky start! He's squared up outside the off stump and gets a thick outside edge which beats slip and runs to third man
straight to Dole at fine leg! Watson's on fire here, he drops it short to the Indian batsman who can't resist the hook, too high on him and he sends it down Dole's throat, he barely had to move
the bouncer again but it sails over his arched back
that's a Ganguly Swat, he backs away to a length ball and swats it just over cover and extra cover
stays beside the line and taps it to point
drops it short down the leg side and he pulls but mistimes it to square leg
fullish in length and pushed with a straight to mid-off
taps it to the off side for a quick single
drops it short and Tiwary flat bats it, not in full control of the shot but he still manages to clear mid-off
it ricochets off the stumps and still runs away for four, powerful straight drive hits the stumps at the bowler's end and yet manages to beat mid-off, top shot
this time he's penalised for bowling it too short, too high for Tiwary to chase
down the leg side and Tiwary tries to tuck it away
drifts on the body and he tucks it to square leg

double strike for Watson! Watson varies his length by banging in the bouncer, Rayudu goes for the hook an he gloves it to Ojha, the umpire Tarapore gives him out immediately but the batsman doesn't walk because Tendulkar reckoned the ball was over the shoulder height, Watson had already bowled one bouncer in the over, the umpires confer and deem it a legal delivery, Warne claps and gives Rayudu a send-off
punched hard back to the bowler and Watson glares at Rayudu
stays behind the line and defends
very soft dismissal! Watson pitches it up outside off and he tamely spoons it down to extra cover who was quite straight, I don't think Watson expected a wicket off that ball
gives him width outside off and he slashes on the up down to third man
bangs it in short and Tendulkar ducks under it safely
full on the pads and clipped straight to deep midwicket where Lumb is in position
no turn this time and it beats him, Ojha breaks the bails but Sachin was safe
easy does it! He bowls this too straight and Tendulkar eases it off his pads, big gap at square leg
this time he clips it straight to mid-on
Tendulkar on fire after smoke delay! Yusuf drops the ball short and flat, he rocks back and cuts wide of point
clips the ball wide of mid-on for a single
starts off with a wide down the leg side, Jayasuriya gets his backfoot back before the keeper whips off the bails
Mumbai have a foot in the door of the semis! Tossed up by Harbhajan and he goes skyward down to wide long-on, Dhawan runs forward and takes the catch
he skies it down to deep square leg and the ball just drops short of Zaheer
clips it down to deep backward square leg
full and pushed down to long-off
clipped to deep backward square leg
full toss on his pads and clipped to deep square leg
he's having some fun there, gets under a full delivery and lofts him high over long-on
makes room and tries to loft inside out but the ball is skied towards deep extra cover, Duminy and Dhawan converge but the ball drops short of both
bowls a slower one and he smashes it down to long-off
squeezes out a low full toss down to long-off
slower ball and he lofts it high and clears long-on, seemed like a mishit at first
chipped in the air but the ball drops well in front of long-on
backs away this time and swishes at thin air
late evening workout here for Dole, he backs away to a short delivery and mows it over midwicket, just drops short of the rope
another yorker and he squirts it out to the off side
aims for the yorker but it's a low full toss squeezed out to point
makes room to a full delivery outside off and scoops it wide of mid-off
punches it down to backward point
clean hit! Drops it a fraction short and he rocks back and clubs it high over deep midwicket
chipped in the air down to long-on
fires in the yorker and it clips his pads just outside the line of the leg stump
the perfume ball! It whistles past the helmet as he sways out of the way
nudged down to fine leg for a single
bangs it short towards the body and he sways back and runs it just wide of the keeper
Runs it down to short third man and decides against the single
knocks it towards cover again
comes round the wicket, gets beside the line and taps it to cover
stays back and knocks it towards mid-on
catching practice for Rayudu, Zaheer drops it short and angles it across the right-hander, he tries to run it down to third man but ends up running it off the face of the bat to the keeper
low full toss and he pushes it to long-off
full on the pads and pushed through the line to long-on
tucks it down to square leg for a single
the slower ball! Very poor shot there, he makes room to slap it over the on side and ends up getting a tame top edge which lobbed to Harbhajan at short third man
you can't bowl it short of a length at a gentle pace to Yusuf because he will club you, he gets  on top of the bounce and smacks it over square leg
placed to the deep on the off side
dispatches the first ball after the time out, he reaches out and slaps a short delivery over the vacant cover point region
another short one gets high on him and he miscues the pull just wide of Zaheer at midwicket
another slower bouncer and Voges fails to slash it away
cuts pretty firmly past point and Duminy quickly gets around to cut it off, they complete the second though
lands it fuller and he jams it back to Malinga
the slower bouncer forces Yusuf to change his mind, he ends up slicing it just wide of backward point
gets bedside the line and steers him just wide of cover point
pulls him down to midwicket
gets beside the line and chops it to the off side
on the body again and he pulls uppishly towards midwicket
Pollard bowls a short one and Yusuf swings and misses
sliced behind point and Tiwary does really well to sprint and save a boundary
short delivery and a slower ball too, gently pulled behind square
full delivery hits the pads but outside the line of leg
drops it to the on side
bowls it full and flat and he pushes it to long-on
on the pads and softly clipped away

appeal for a run out! And it is! The batsman clips it behind square on the on side and challenges Tiwary running in, Jhunjhunwala charges for the second run but it's a flat and accurate throw to the keeper who whips off the bails with the  batsman just short of his ground, the third umpire takes a look
clips it wide of midwicket and thinks of the second run
fired outside off and he jams it out to short third man
full on the pads and clipped to midwicket
tossed up on middle and leg and pushed to long-on
full on the stumps and pushed to long-off
he slides down the leg side and the ball trickles away down to fine leg, beats Malinga
clips it to midwicket
comes down the track and squeezes it out to long-on
well bowled! Saw him coming and fired it flat and quick, the batsman yorked himself
stays back and tucks it behind square
continues round the wicket, he stays at the crease and clips it to midwicket
gets a leading edge to the off side
stays back and thumps it over the bowler's head but long-of picks it up
plays it with soft hands to long-on
on the pads and clipped down to Duminy at long-on
clips him down to deep midwicket for two more
tucks it towards deep midwicket, misfield by Sathish
tucks it towards square leg for a single
down the leg side
pushed towards mid-of and there's hesitation in the calling again, Jhunjhunwala is sent back
full on the off stump and drives to deep extra cover

Communication Breakdown again! Fazal drops the ball towards short point and tells his partner to wait, but Jhunjhunwala wanted the single and was past the halfway mark, Fazal jogs to the other end but it's too late as Jayasuriya throws to Harbhajan
steps down the pitch to club i down the ground but he ends up mistiming it to long-on
quick bouncer and it sails over Rayudu's head! Fazal tries to hook
drops it towards short point and sets off for a single
Rajasthan need more of those soon! Jhunjhunwala picks a length ball directed at his body and clubs it rows over deep square leg
punches it straight to Pollard at backward point, he fumbles and that allows a single
backs away and tries to carve it over the infield on the off side but misses
the slower ball aimed at the stumps and he manages to flick it away to midwicket
drops it back of a length and he pulls but doesn't control it, drops between square and fine leg
short and wide outside off and he cuts uppishly to third man
angles it on the body and he clips it towards square leg
steered straight to Pollard at extra cover, packed off side field
fullish in length outside off and driven towards mid-off
hits a good length outside off and he doesn't make contact
bangs it in short and he ducks under the bouncer, even Kulkarni gives him the glare
flicked wide of mid-on
streaky! Drives away from the body on one leg and gets an inside edge past the stumps and the keeper
short down the leg side and plays a flat pull to fine leg on the first bounce
gets forward and defends with soft hands
full outside off and defended to the off side
short and too quick for Fazal

Mumbai on a roll! Watson gets a half stride forward and gets an inside edge past the stumps, he never wanted the single in the first place but Fazal was determined to catch the next flight, Watson had no choice but to scamper to the other end, the throw from the keeper was screeching towards the stumps at the bowler's end but Zaheer very cleverly left it and it was a direct hit awesome stuff there
Fazal drops it with soft hands towards short point and takes a easy single
full outside off and angles it to third man to get off the mark

The man with the orange cap takes it! Zaheer troubled Ojha last over with his away movement and this time he finally induced the thick outside edge, Tendulkar judges it well at first slip, falls to his left and cups it
stabbed towards point and he doesn't take the run
well taken! Good length outside off and Lumb shapes to cut past backward point, he fails to keep it down and Duminy shows good reflexes in diving to his right to collect it
poor ball again, he feeds him another short one and this time he pulls behind square, beats Harbhajan at square leg
gets beside the line and taps it to the off side
drops it a fraction short and Lumb swivels and clubs it over square leg, clean hit
another peach of an away swinger beats Ojha
another lucky escape for Lumb! Ojha clips it towards silly midwicket and calls for a risky run, Lumb was sent back and Zaheer's throw was wide at his end, Lumb was miles out
beautiful away swinger, beats Ojha all ends up

chance for a run out! The ball clips his pads and rolls to the off side, stifled appeal for lbw and the batsmen steal a leg bye, Lumb was an absolute goner but Jayasuriya fails to collect the throw at the bowler's end
fantastic delivery and fantastic keeping! The leg cutter squares up Lumb outside off and the ball sneaks past off stump, Rayudu moves to his right and then moves to his left and takes it one handed
